parole.significato: a male given name meaning “sea”, of Buryat usage
parole.testo: Borrowed from Classical Mongolian ᠵᠠᠮᠰᠤ (ǰamsu), from Classical Tibetan རྒྱ་མཚོ (rgya mtsho).

Borrowed from Classical Mongolian ᠢᠷᠪᠢᠰ (irbis), modern ирвэс (irves), from Proto-Mongolic *irbis, from Proto-Common Turkic *irbiš whence within the distribution of the animal Uzbek ilvirs, Uyghur يىلپىز (yilpiz), Kyrgyz илбирс (ilbirs), Kazakh ілбіс (ilbis).
Borrowed from Classical Mongolian ᠮᠣᠩᠭᠣᠯ (mongɣol), from Middle Mongol ᠮᠣᠩᠬᠣᠯ (mongqol).
